newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Universal Robina to go into packaging.
newsitem.headline: Universal Robina to go into packaging.

text.p: Universal Robina Corp, the food manufacturing arm of JG Summit Holdings Inc, will start manufacturing packaging materials, Lance Gokongwei, the company's executive vice president, said on Wednesday.
He said URC has just contracted the delivery of equipment to make biaxially oriented polypropylene (BOPP) film.
The plant will be built in Batangas, south of Manila. It would be adjacent to the petrochemical plant of JG Summit Petrochemical Corp, an affiliate of URC, the company said.
The project will be operational by the end of 1997 and will make use of polypropylene resins to be manufacture by JG Summit Petrochemical, the company said.
